title: Continuing independent diagnostics must not turn a failed gate into a pass
failureDescription: Both core cells failed in run 23 while the other six cells passed. In that revision, a failed assertion inside a diagnostic helper could stop the core cell before later material and first-entry observations were collected. The exact failed assertion is not available here; this candidate targets the source-confirmed evidence-starvation path, not a claimed root cause for run 23.
mustNeverRepeat: Treat an independent diagnostic mismatch as permission to skip later safe observations.
Treat a nonfatal diagnostic record as ignored or passing evidence.
Let Producer set passed=true when any recorded required check is false.
Continue after a failed prerequisite when later execution would be invalid or unsafe.
requiredEvidence: exact tested commit and workflow run
explicit fatal prerequisite versus independent diagnostic classification
all safely reachable diagnostic records, including failures
required helper presence and helper final verdict
aggregate proof that every required recorded check passed

gateLogic.fatal: Abort only when a prerequisite failure makes later execution invalid, unsafe, or semantically meaningless.
gateLogic.diagnostic: Record the failure and continue to later independent safe observations.
gateLogic.pass: The cell and aggregate pass only when every recorded required check is true and every required helper exists and passes.
gateLogic.hold: Any recorded false check, missing helper, failed helper, unsafe prerequisite, incomplete result, or wrong subject identity rejects the candidate.

appliesTo: Other Mother verifier suites only after a local trial classifies safe independent diagnostics
activationRequirement: Kuko-local implementation has a passed exact-subject public run. Keep this case inactive for other Mothers; global adoption requires a separate trial in another affected Mother and an independent receipt.
